name: Nevada

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: OCIO Guideline 101 rev 2.1 — ADA Technology Accessibility Guidelines (effective 2019-07-22)
State of Nevada Digital Accessibility Statement

applies_to: All State of Nevada departments, agencies, boards, commissions and other state entities; ICT acquired or developed, incl. previously published material.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Appoint agency Accessibility/ADA Coordinator(s) to the ADA working group
Coordinators create detailed agency remediation plans
Follow OCIO guideline (WCAG 2.1 + Section 508); state provides Siteimprove scanning
mobile: implied — guideline covers software applications and all ICT; statement names web pages and PDFs; mobile not named in the guideline.
procurement: Guideline covers ICT 'acquired'; no specific VPAT/ACR or contract clause verified.
enforcement: Guideline says it is enforced via Sections 504/508; no state penalty. Feedback to adaremediation@it.nv.gov / Digital Accessibility Program Coordinator.
notes: The state accessibility statement cites NRS Chapter 242 / NRS 242.131 as the mandate, but NRS 242.131 as read concerns OCIO services and cybersecurity, with no accessibility language; no Nevada accessibility statute confirmed. Guideline dates from 2019 and may be superseded by unpublished internal policy.
